chunks: They said, 'Build a pyre for him and throw him into the raging fire.'
ai.seo_question: What did Pharaoh's people tell him to build for Prophet Ibrahim?
ai.summary: In this verse, Pharaoh's courtiers advise him to construct a towering pyre (burning wood) to elevate Ibrahim, reflecting the ancient Egyptian belief that height would bring the fire closer to the heavens or the god of fire. This command underscores the arrogance of tyrants who rely on human engineering and material power to defeat divine prophets, a theme later echoed in the construction of the Tower of Babel in Islamic exegesis.
